title: DR1 lists the selected commodities and their animal counts above the identification form, with links to change or add one; the frontend shows neither

finding.frontend: The page goes straight from the inset text to the first species card. There is no summary of what was selected, and once at least one commodity line exists there is no way to add another from here — the only links out of the page are Back, Cancel and return to hub, and the service navigation. An "Add a commodity" link does exist but only in the empty state, when no commodity has been added at all: src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.njk:27-32 puts it in the `else` branch of the has-lines test, so the user who has one commodity and wants a second must leave the page.
finding.prototype: Between the inset text and the species panels DR1 shows a "Selected commodities" heading and a table with a row per commodity, columns Commodity code, Common name and Number of animals, and a Change link on each row that returns to the commodity search with the search reset. Below the table sits an "Add another commodity" link. The block is in app/views/animal-identification-details.html:55-83 and it is visible in the dr1-animal-identification-details capture, showing 0102 / Cattle / 2.
finding.difference: Add a summary block above the identification cards, built from the stored commodity lines: code, common name and number of animals per line, with a Change link per row back to the commodity picker and an "Add another commodity" link below. The data is already on the page — the card view model in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/card/view-model.js:84-118 reads the same lines and derives the code from the commodity name at :22-28. The number of animals comes from the line's numberOfAnimals answer. Decide where the Change link lands: DR1 returns to the commodity search rather than the consignment-details number question, which is what the separate "Change number of animals" link does.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a selected-commodities table or an add-another-commodity link rendered anywhere on the frontend identification page — the whole page markup is in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.njk and the card macro it includes.
